meta.title: Wyrfl – cube puzzles for your spatial thinking
meta.description: Wyrfl is a free cube-building puzzle: recognise views from the top, front and side, and rebuild structures. No sign-up, no ads.

home.tagline: Train your spatial thinking – with cube buildings.
home.dragHint: Swipe across the building to turn it. The yellow edge is the front.
home.viewsTitle: This is what the building looks like …
home.noWebgl: Sorry, your browser can't show 3D graphics.

guess.title: Guess the view
guess.text: Which picture shows the building from the front? Find the right one out of six.

build.title: Build it
build.text: You get three blueprints – place the cubes so everything fits.

timeAttack.title: Time Attack
timeAttack.text: As many puzzles as you can – against the clock. Only if you're in the mood.

about.title: About Wyrfl
about.intro: Wyrfl is a puzzle game for kids and teens (and everyone else) that trains your spatial thinking: you translate between 3D cube buildings and their views from the top, front and side.
about.privacy: Wyrfl needs no sign-up, shows no ads and collects no data. Your progress stays on your device only.
about.license: Wyrfl is free software under the MIT license – schools, teachers and everyone else may use, copy and adapt it.
about.openSource: Wyrfl is built on great open-source projects. Thanks to everyone who contributes to them!

libs.astro: Generates the pages as static HTML
libs.vitest: Automated tests of the game logic

level.label: Difficulty
level.locked: Solve {count} puzzles in “{level}” to open this one.

guess.question: What does the building look like {view}?
guess.sideNote: “From the right” means: you stand at the front and walk around the building to the right.
guess.tryAgain: Not yet – give it another try!
guess.hintDone: Look: this is the building {view}. Which picture matches?

why.fromBack: That’s mirrored – it’s the building seen from the back.
why.fromLeft: That’s mirrored – it’s the building seen from the left.
why.isSide: That’s the view from the right, not from the front.
why.isFront: That’s the view from the front, not from the right.
why.otherSide: That’s the view from a different side.
why.rotated: That’s turned around. Seen from the top, the front (yellow edge) is always at the bottom.
why.mirrorTop: That’s mirrored – left and right are swapped.
why.flipped: Front and back are swapped. Seen from the top, the front is always at the bottom.
why.nearMiss: So close! Take another look at the marked squares.

build.intro: Build a building that matches all three blueprints. Tap a blueprint to see your building from that direction.
build.tapHint: Tap a square or a cube. Swipe to turn the building.
build.full: Can’t go higher – at most {max} cubes on top of each other.
build.success: Great! Your building matches all three blueprints.
build.successNote: By the way: there is often more than one right answer.
build.almost: Almost! The dashed squares don’t match yet.
build.empty: Put a few cubes on the board first.
